clock_note: generated_at is a fixed reproducibility stamp, not the wall-clock execution time.

process.calendar_note: Fixed ten reusable panels; two weekly slots each. Capacity is evaluator-hour allocation, not panel additions.

evidence.note: Directly sampled observable response structures, independently per source/skill; no candidate-level trait or score. Channel is not an input.

levels.LIMITED: 구체적 행동은 있으나 검증이나 개인 기여 확인이 부족함
levels.MODERATE: 직접 수행한 구체적 행동과 검증을 확인함
levels.STRONG: 검증 결과에 따른 변경과 재검증을 확인함

rubric.ambiguity: 공동 산출물에서 개인 검증 범위가 불명확하면 ML 평가자는 LIMITED, 맥락 중심 현업 평가자는 MODERATE를 제안할 수 있다. 원문이 범위를 해소하지 않으면 미합의로 보존한다.
rubric.calibration: Persisted observations only; positive direct evidence may contextualize earlier limitations; same-evidence evaluator differences remain explicit. No averaging or recency override.
rubric.decision_policy: Stage-specific criteria; INITIAL HOLD for missing/unresolved Must. One focused follow-up; re-review weighs explicit adverse observations, accepts residual missing-only uncertainty with work support, never auto-fails missing evidence.

hold.re_review_policy: Positive direct coverage supports proceed; repeated explicit limitations or unresolved adverse observations support human non-proceed. Missing-only residual uncertainty is accepted with scoped onboarding support.

implementation_parameters.randomness: keyed streams retain v0.1 namespace to isolate rule changes; no seed search; unchanged legacy pattern/contact weights
implementation_parameters.stage_failure: FIRST A core01/02/03 direct current coverage required; B explicit agreed limitation -> failed; C/D -> evidence pending; no score or quota
implementation_parameters.document_eligibility: No verified public basic requirements available; no invented failure criterion
implementation_parameters.onboarding: Learnable gaps plus local work-prep requirements with selection level below STRONG; all required gap tasks need verified work and mentor confirmation
implementation_parameters.response_window: 14 days, SYNTHETIC assumption, not employer policy
implementation_parameters.capacity: 30 fixed evaluators; Initial 2h each; additional whole 1h per evaluator rounds cover observed interview gap; calibration accounted separately
implementation_parameters.censoring: planned appointments/deadlines may exceed end; actual events may not
implementation_parameters.human_decisions: offline SYNTHETIC_HUMAN_SCENARIO, not operational hiring automation
implementation_parameters.pool_scheduling: Reserve only occupied activity blocks; future follow-up reservations do not block earlier free intervals. No personal working-day/holiday calendar.

interview.calibration_trigger: current direct observation LIMITED/NOT_OBSERVED or interpretation disagreement
interview.scenario_note: PeopleOps synthetic scenario; secondary interview references, not official Kia policy

targeted_followup.sampling: equal weights within the unresolved question category; keyed by input snapshot; no ordinary evidence pattern call
